page_text_ocr_zh:
夏天是绿蠵(xī)龟产卵的季节，绿蠵龟妈妈花了两三个月的时间，千里迢迢游回自己出生的海滩，准备产卵。这里是绿蠵龟妈妈平安出生的地方，再次回到这里，它心想：“希望我的宝宝也能在这里平安长大。”

绿蠵龟喜欢吃海藻、水母、小章鱼和乌贼。

绿蠵龟是现存七种海龟中的一种。它们生活在世界各地的温暖海水中，长大后的绿蠵龟，每隔两到三年，就会游回到出生地的沙滩上产卵。
3/11
page_text_en:
Summer is the season when green sea turtles lay eggs. The mother green sea turtle spends two to three months swimming thousands of miles back to the beach where she was born, preparing to lay her eggs. This is the place where the mother green sea turtle was safely born. Returning here again, she thinks, 'I hope my baby can also grow up safely here.'

Green sea turtles like to eat seaweed, jellyfish, small octopuses, and squid.

The green sea turtle is one of the seven existing species of sea turtles. They live in warm seas around the world. After growing up, green sea turtles return to the beach where they were born to lay eggs every two to three years.
3/11
summary_zh: 本页描绘了绿蠵龟妈妈在夏天游回出生地海滩产卵的场景，并介绍了绿蠵龟的习性和生活特点。

page_text_ocr_zh:
趁着黑夜爬上沙滩
黑夜是产卵最安全的时候。绿蠵龟妈妈背着厚厚的壳，拖着沉重的脚步，努力地爬上岸。它不停地往陆地上爬，因为它明白：“把卵产在沙滩最高处，涨潮的时候海浪才不会卷走我的小宝宝。”
成年绿蠵龟的体重超过100千克，它们是海里的游泳高手，但是在陆地上爬行却很困难。它们为了适应海中的生活，四肢的形状已经变成船桨般的鳍肢，适合游泳，却不适合爬行。
绿蠵龟妈妈担心的事
担心产下的卵泡在水里。
担心海浪卷走刚产下的卵。
担心产下的卵藏得不够隐秘。
page_text_en:
Climbing the Beach at Night
The night is the safest time to lay eggs. The green sea turtle mother, carrying her thick shell and dragging her heavy steps, struggles to climb ashore. She keeps crawling onto the land because she knows: "I must lay my eggs at the highest point of the beach, so the waves won't wash away my little babies when the tide comes in."
Adult green sea turtles weigh over 100 kilograms. They are swimming champions in the sea, but crawling on land is very difficult for them. To adapt to life in the ocean, their limbs have evolved into paddle-like flippers, perfect for swimming, but not for crawling.
What the Green Sea Turtle Mother Worries About
Worries that the laid eggs will be submerged in water.
Worries that the waves will wash away the newly laid eggs.
Worries that the laid eggs are not hidden well enough.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了绿蠵龟妈妈在黑夜中艰难爬上沙滩产卵的场景，解释了她选择在高处产卵的原因，并列出了她对卵的三大担忧：被水淹没、被海浪卷走和不够隐蔽。

page_text_ocr_zh:
为宝宝挑选安全的沙滩
绿蠵龟妈妈爬上沙滩后，如果发现沙滩太脏，或者
出现其他会伤害宝宝的动物，它就不产卵，重新爬回海
里，再游到其他沙滩看看，直到找到安全又舒适的地点。

如果海滩上出现垃圾，或是会偷吃海龟卵的动物，绿蠵龟妈妈
就不太愿意在这里产卵。

绿蠵龟妈妈担心的事

担心海龟卵会被野狗或人挖走吃掉。 担心垃圾污染，影响海龟卵的发育。

担心废弃物阻碍小海龟回到海里。 担心灯光误导小海龟爬行的方向，致
使小海龟迷路。

绿蠵龟妈妈说：“我宁愿自己辛苦一点，也不要宝宝出
生在既危险又脏乱的地方。”

我想要干净
的沙滩。
page_text_en:
Choosing a Safe Beach for Baby Turtles
After the green sea turtle mother climbs onto the beach, if she finds the sand too dirty, or if other animals that might harm her babies are present, she will not lay her eggs. Instead, she will crawl back into the sea, swim to other beaches, and keep searching until she finds a safe and comfortable spot.

If there is trash on the beach, or animals that might steal turtle eggs, the green sea turtle mother will not be willing to lay her eggs there.

Things the Green Sea Turtle Mother Worries About

Worries that turtle eggs will be dug up and eaten by wild dogs or people. Worries that trash pollution will affect the development of turtle eggs.

Worries that waste will block baby turtles from returning to the sea. Worries that lights will mislead baby turtles, causing them to get lost.

The green sea turtle mother says: "I'd rather suffer a little myself than have my baby born in a dangerous and messy place."

I want a clean
beach.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了绿蠵龟妈妈为宝宝挑选安全沙滩的过程，她会避开有垃圾或天敌的海滩，并列举了她对卵和幼龟的四大担忧：被挖走、受污染、被废弃物阻碍以及被灯光误导迷路。

page_text_ocr_zh:
挖产卵洞要注意的事

绿蠵龟妈妈找到满意的
产卵地点后，会先用前肢拨
开沙子，挖出一个大洞，把
沙地弄平整；然后，再用后
肢往下挖一个产卵洞，准备
产卵。怀孕的绿蠵龟妈妈为
了在天亮前产下卵，一刻也
不敢休息。

绿蠵龟妈妈产卵的沙滩不能太硬
或太松软。如果沙滩太硬，很难
挖开沙子；如果太松软，挖开的
沙洞很难维持固定的形状。

担心产卵洞挖得太浅，海龟卵容易被
蛇或野狗挖出来吃掉。

担心产卵洞挖得太深，小宝宝孵出

所以，产卵洞深 60～70 厘米比较

生下来了！

page_text_en:
Things to Pay Attention to When Digging a Nesting Hole

After finding a satisfactory nesting site, the green sea turtle mother first uses her front flippers to dig up the sand, creating a large hole and leveling the ground. Then, she uses her hind flippers to dig a nesting hole, preparing to lay her eggs. The pregnant green sea turtle mother dares not rest for a moment, as she must lay her eggs before dawn.

The beach where the green sea turtle mother lays her eggs must not be too hard or too soft. If the sand is too hard, it's difficult to dig; if it's too soft, the dug hole will be hard to maintain its shape.

Things the Green Sea Turtle Mother Worries About

Worried that if the nesting hole is dug too shallow, the turtle eggs will be easily dug up and eaten by snakes or wild dogs.

Worried that if the nesting hole is dug too deep, the baby turtles won't be able to crawl out after hatching.

Therefore, a nesting hole depth of 60-70 centimeters is most suitable.

The nesting hole is almost ready! Just a little longer, and I can give birth to my babies!

6/11
summary_zh: 本页详细介绍了绿蠵龟妈妈在沙滩上挖掘产卵洞的过程、对沙滩硬度的要求，以及她对产卵洞深度的担忧，最终确定60-70厘米为最合适的深度。

page_text_ocr_zh:
产了卵也担心
绿蠵龟妈妈在挖好的洞里，耐心地产下了一百多枚卵。海龟卵像小皮球一样很有弹性，掉进洞里也不会破。产完卵后，绿蠵龟妈妈又小心地把沙子填回洞里。这时候，绿蠵龟妈妈已经上岸好几个小时，身体非常疲倦了。但是，它会说：“只要宝宝能平安，我再累都值得。”
绿蠵龟妈妈一次会产下100～150枚卵。在产卵的季节，它们通常会上岸产卵3～5次，所以总共可以产下500～600枚卵。
绿蠵龟妈妈担心的事
担心同一个洞里有太多的卵，有些卵会得不到温暖。
担心太多的小海龟孵出时，会互相推挤，爬不出来。
担心把卵产在一个洞里不安全，所以分次产在不同的地方。
page_text_en:
Worried Even After Laying Eggs
The green sea turtle mother carefully lays over a hundred eggs in the hole she dug. Turtle eggs are very elastic, like small rubber balls, and won't break even if they fall into the hole. After laying the eggs, the green sea turtle mother carefully fills the hole back with sand. By now, she has been on shore for several hours and is very tired. But she thinks: "As long as my babies are safe, I'm worth it, no matter how tired I am."
A green sea turtle mother lays 100 to 150 eggs at a time. During the breeding season, they usually come ashore to lay eggs 3 to 5 times, so they can lay a total of 500 to 600 eggs.
Things the Green Sea Turtle Mother Worries About
Worries that if there are too many eggs in the same hole, some eggs won't get enough warmth.
Worries that if too many baby turtles hatch at once, they will push against each other and won't be able to crawl out.
Worries that laying eggs in one hole is unsafe, so she lays them in different places during different times.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了绿蠵龟妈妈在沙滩上产卵后，将沙子填回洞中，并表达了她对宝宝安全的牵挂。同时，通过图文并茂的方式，列出了她对卵和幼龟的三大担忧：卵无法获得足够温暖、幼龟孵化时互相推挤无法爬出、以及为安全起见需分次在不同地点产卵。

page_text_ocr_zh:
请太阳公公帮忙孵卵
当绿蠵龟妈妈仔细地将沙子盖回产卵洞后，天已经快亮了，它拖着疲倦的身子依依不舍地爬回大海。最后，绿蠵龟妈妈说：“接下来的工作就拜托太阳公公了，请您用阳光温暖我的宝宝，让它们健康长大。”
我走了，接下来就麻烦您了！
没问题，看我的！
绿蠵龟不会孵卵。它们利用温暖的阳光，把海龟卵四周的沙子晒热，这样，卵才有足够的温度孵化。
孵出来的海龟宝宝，会努力往地面上爬，一起爬出沙洞。
沙子的温度也会决定海龟宝宝的性别。通常温度低于28℃时，会孵化出雄龟；高于30℃时，会孵化出雌龟；28℃～30℃之间，则雌、雄都有可能。

page_text_en:
Please Help Hatch the Eggs, Mr. Sun
After the green sea turtle mother carefully covers the nest with sand, it's almost dawn. She drags her tired body back to the sea, reluctant to leave. Finally, the green sea turtle mother says, "The next job is entrusted to you, Mr. Sun. Please warm my babies with your sunlight and help them grow up healthy." 
I'm leaving, the next part is up to you!
No problem, watch me!
Green sea turtles don't incubate their eggs. They use warm sunlight to heat the sand around the eggs, so the eggs have enough temperature to hatch.
The hatchlings will struggle to crawl to the surface and emerge from the sand together.
The temperature of the sand also determines the gender of the baby turtles. Usually, temperatures below 28°C will hatch male turtles; above 30°C will hatch female turtles; between 28°C and 30°C, both males and females are possible.
8/11
summary_zh: 本页描绘了绿蠵龟妈妈产卵后返回大海，将孵化任务托付给太阳，并介绍了海龟卵依靠阳光孵化的原理，以及沙温对幼龟性别的影响。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小海龟重回大海
两个月后的一个清晨，沙滩下的小海龟终于出生了。它们一个个钻出沙子爬出来，朝着海面发出的微光，奔向大海。虽然沙滩上有无数的敌人在等待着它们，但是小海龟依然勇敢地迎接挑战。
小海龟爬向大海时，会遇到许多天敌，如海鸟、蜥蜴、螃蟹、猫、狗或人等。因为它们的壳是软的，所以很容易被吃掉。
大海，我来了！妈妈，我会成为一只勇敢的海龟。
page_text_en:
Little Sea Turtles Return to the Ocean
Two months later, on a morning, the baby sea turtles born under the sand finally hatch. One by one, they dig out of the sand and crawl toward the faint light of the sea surface, rushing to the ocean. Although countless enemies wait for them on the beach, the baby turtles still bravely face the challenge.
When baby sea turtles crawl toward the ocean, they encounter many predators, such as seabirds, lizards, crabs, cats, dogs, or humans. Because their shells are soft, they are very easy to be eaten.
Ocean, here I come! Mom, I will become a brave sea turtle.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了小海龟在两个月后破壳而出，勇敢爬向大海的场景，介绍了它们在途中面临的天敌威胁，并通过对话展现了小海龟对未来的勇气与期待。
画面描绘了两只绿蠵龟在沙滩上，一只位于前景，另一只在背景靠近海浪处，它们正缓缓爬行，似乎刚完成产卵或准备返回大海，背景是宁静的夜海与沙滩。
